subject: Qwen service also consumes ~5 GiB private commit; stopping it may clear both VRAM and 8 GiB commit gate
body: Read-only process memory audit after patched live preflight HOLD: qwen_http PID5888 has ~4998.4 MiB private commit and 3193 MiB GPU memory. Live host preflight on committed N/A proposal f3a6080 showed available physical 10.436 GiB but commit headroom only 3.192 GiB (<8). Therefore intentional ProRun Qwen shutdown should free roughly 5 GiB of private commit as well as GPU VRAM, plausibly bringing commit headroom just above the frozen 8 GiB minimum. Largest other commit consumer is a Firefox content process (~12.6 GiB private); do not touch browser/user workload preemptively. After safe supervisor/watchdog stop, re-run live preflight and require actual PASS rather than assuming the projected recovery.
